definitions.explanation: Having skill in using one's hands or managing practical tasks.
Able to handle many different things well.

examples.japanese: {器用|きよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{折|お}り{紙|がみ}→折り紙：05408_origami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手先|てさき}→手先：12939_tesaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{器用|きよう}で、⟦{何|なん}でも→何でも：00304_nandemo⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: She's good with her hands and can make anything.

examples.english: As the saying 'jack of all trades, master of none' suggests, someone who can do anything may have difficulty mastering one thing.

notes:
{器用|きよう} describes skill with hands or general capability.

FORMS:
- {器用|きよう}な (attributive form)
- {器用|きよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverb: skillfully)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{手先|てさき}→手先：12939_tesaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{器用|きよう} (good with one's hands)
- {器用|きよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧ (to handle skillfully)
